description: Empirical net-plant-efficiency curve vs resource temperature. eta_net(T) tabulated from eta = eta_utilization * eta_Carnot at the F1a design rejection temperature. 1-D np.interp lookup.
source: DiPippo, R. (2015). Geothermal Power Plants, 4th ed. Butterworth-Heinemann. Breakpoints reuse EC151 F1a exergy-model design numbers (eta_utilization=0.55, T_reject=50 degC).

T_reject_ref.note: Rejection temperature at which the efficiency curve was tabulated (F1a design)

eta_utilization.note: Direct-steam utilization efficiency reused from F1a

eta_net_rated.note: Net plant efficiency at T_geo=200 degC, T_reject=50 degC

curve.note: Net plant efficiency vs resource temperature (degC) at T_reject=50 degC. eta = 0.55*(1 - (Trej+273.15)/(Tgeo+273.15)).
